text: Before a big change, the universe always sends three signs.
You keep seeing the same hours, again and again.
Someone from your past suddenly comes back to your mind.
The third sign is the hardest one.
Things that used to fit your life simply stop fitting.
If you noticed all three this month, it is not a coincidence.
Comment SIGN, and go to my stories.
Your three cards will show you what is changing.
